Likewise the operations and personnel transferred together as a going concern, so T5 and T6 moved coherently alongside each other (gap_56=0); the acquiror's charter continued unchanged (T3 terminate for Green) and Veritex's CEO/board continuity with three Green directors joining reflects partial T6 transfer, but nothing documents processes moving without their people at closing. T1 is coded replace because Veritex's charter documents and CEO controlled the surviving corporation while Green ceased to exist, despite the ~55% Green share split.
